kind: Actual remote Supabase Auth/RLS, read-only records; session persistence uses SDK memory storage. Mutating security tests use rolled-back SQL fixtures.

results.name: Worker and employer authenticate in separate actual Supabase sessions
Eight application tables deny unauthenticated data
Other worker shifts and skills are unreadable
Both worker and employer are isolated from unassigned organization
Employer receives no raw feedback, identities, or comments
SDK restores a persisted authenticated session (memory adapter, not browser)
Local logout clears persisted session and preserves independent employer session
